newsitem.title: USA: CPAC's Fuller Brush in marketing alliance.
newsitem.headline: CPAC's Fuller Brush in marketing alliance.

text.p: CPAC Inc's Fuller Brush Co and Publishers Clearing House said Monday they entered into a strategic alliance to promote Fuller Brush products.
The new multi-year exclusive agreement allows Publishers Clearing House to market Fuller products in select distribution channels in the United States and England.
"This agreement allows us to aggressively pursue expanded use of Fuller products for our highly selective customers," Robin Smith, chairman of Publishers Clearing House, said in a statement.
Fuller Brush produces and markets specialty chemicals, brushes and brooms for the cleaning and personal care industry.
